questions.question: AMBIGUOUS most nearly means:
questions.explanation: Ambiguous means open to more than one interpretation; unclear or uncertain.
steps: 1. Understand meaning: ambiguous = having multiple possible meanings.
3. Uncertain best captures the essence of ambiguity.
questions.fastStrategy: Ambiguous = unclear, open to interpretation; opposite of clear/definite.

questions.question: SUCCINCT most nearly means:
questions.explanation: Succinct means expressed in very few words; concise and brief.
steps: 1. Understand meaning: succinct = brief, to the point.
questions.fastStrategy: Succinct = brief, clear, minimal words; closely related to concise.

questions.question: METICULOUS most nearly means:
questions.explanation: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail; extremely careful and precise.
steps: 2. Evaluate: Careless (antonym), Careful (synonym), Meteoric (unrelated), Methodical (related but not as direct).
questions.fastStrategy: Meticulous = extreme attention to detail; synonymous with careful and precise.
